[NCBK.6.5] **Adapter-side timeouts, not engine-side** (LCRS.7.3). libds does not
track per-call deadlines and never synthesises a response fact or a
`CallError`. Adapters assert `CallError` on timeout; authors react to absence
with a `timeout` continuation or a negated pattern over the response schema
bounded by `within` ([LCRS.7.1]).
